d:
Gwyneth Paltrow, Co-Founder & General Partner of Kinship Ventures and CEO and Founder of Goop Inc, and Moj Mahdara, Co-Founder & Managing Partner of Kinship Ventures, joined Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick to discuss the venture capital firm’s approach to early and late stage investing, the names in their portfolio, the future of wellness and more.
